import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

// Cairntrace page prelude: window.__cairn helpers and browser.appHandle accessors,
// installed before page JavaScript that uses __cairn (as `cairn run` does).
const CAIRN_PRELUDE = "<cairn prelude>";

/** wait: { app } — true once the handle value at `path` passes `check`. */
async function cairnAppCheck(page: Page, path: string, check: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<boolean> {
  return page
    .evaluate(
      async ({ source, path, check }) => {
        const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () {}).constructor as new (...parameters: string[]) => (...values: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;
        const answer = (await new AsyncFunction("path", "check", source + "return __cairn.__appCheck(path, check);")(path, check)) as { ok?: boolean };
        return answer.ok === true;
      },
      { source: CAIRN_PRELUDE, path, check },
    )
    .catch((error: unknown) => {
      // A strict CSP blocks the string evaluation: say so instead of polling to a timeout.
      const message = String((error as { message?: unknown } | undefined)?.message ?? error);
      if (/EvalError|unsafe-eval|Content Security Policy/i.test(message)) {
        throw new Error("wait: { app } cannot run: the page's Content Security Policy blocks string evaluation (" + message.split("\n")[0] + "); set use.bypassCSP: true in the Playwright config");
      }
      return false;
    });
}

test("golden_prelude", async ({ page }) => {
  // Derived from sequential step/outcome budgets (+10% headroom, at least 1m); 4h ceiling.
  test.setTimeout(193000);
